title: CCI Clears KKR-Backed Maybach's Full Takeover of Sahrudaya Health Care's Hospital Network
case_name: Acquisition of Sahrudaya Health Care Private Limited by Maybach Asia Holdings II Pte. Ltd.
citation: CCI Press Release dated 21 October 2026 (PIB release ID 2326892, posted 22 October 2026)
card_summary: The CCI approved the acquisition of 100% of Sahrudaya Health Care by Maybach Asia Holdings II Pte. Ltd., a vehicle owned by funds advised by KKR subsidiaries. Sahrudaya, through its subsidiaries, runs a hospital network of 28 hospitals and units with about 4,800 beds across south and west India. The Commission found no competition concerns and said a detailed order would follow separately.
card_tip: Clearance at this stage is only the press release; the detailed order can still carry conditions, so check it once published before treating the deal as unconditionally closed.
verification_notes: Approval date (21 October 2026, a Wednesday) confirmed via LiveLawBiz; the Press Information Bureau release (posted 22 October 2026) and Medical Buyer both give the same deal structure and hospital/bed count (28 hospitals/units, about 4,800 beds). Earlier trade reports from August 2026 on the underlying roughly EUR 1.2 billion KKR-Medicover sale cite a different hospital/bed count (26 hospitals, 6,000+ beds); card uses only the CCI's own figures from its approval release, not the earlier deal-announcement figures.
